title: Prefund Account Parameters by Tier — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
The Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service pays workers out of money the employer has prefunded. The parameters that govern that prefund balance — deposit size, balance ceiling, ACH availability, wire charges, automatic replenishment and the default low-balance alert — are set by tier as follows.

| Tier | Smallest prefund deposit (USD) | Largest prefund balance (USD) | Business days before an ACH deposit can be disbursed | Fee per incoming wire deposit (USD) | Automatic replenishment may be authorized | Smallest automatic replenishment debit (USD) | Alert level set at enrollment when the employer chooses none (USD) | Disbursement may take the balance below zero |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 100 | 25000 | 2 | 15.00 | no | 0.00 | 100 | no |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 100 | 75000 | 2 | 15.00 | yes | 500.00 | 250 | no |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 100 | 250000 | 1 | 10.00 | yes | 1000.00 | 500 | no |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 100 | 750000 | 1 | 10.00 | yes | 2500.00 | 1000 | no |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 100 | 2500000 | 1 | 0.00 | yes | 10000.00 | 5000 | no |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 100 | 7500000 | 0 | 0.00 | yes | 25000.00 | 10000 | no |

## Parameter definitions

- **Smallest prefund deposit** — smallest prefund deposit (USD).
- **Largest prefund balance** — largest prefund balance; a deposit that would exceed it is returned (USD).
- **ACH availability** — business days after receipt before an ACH deposit can be disbursed (count).
- **Wire deposit fee** — fee per incoming wire deposit (USD).
- **Automatic replenishment may be authorized** — whether the employer may authorize automatic ACH debits when the balance falls below its alert level.
- **Smallest automatic replenishment debit** — smallest automatic replenishment debit (USD).
- **Default low-balance alert** — alert level set at enrollment when the employer chooses none (USD).
- **Balance below zero** — whether a disbursement may take the prefund balance below zero.

## Notes across tiers

- Only Starter does not permit automatic replenishment; its smallest replenishment debit is shown as 0.00 for that reason.
- An ACH deposit on Enterprise can be disbursed on the day it is received (0 business days); on Growth, Pro and Scale it waits 1 business day and on Starter and Core 2 business days.
- No tier lets a disbursement take the prefund balance below zero.
